# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is short, fat, and bald, with a round face and prominent blue eyes. When angry, his face can turn purple and his eyes protrude intensely. After his wife rejoined him, he appeared neat and snug, kept himself shaved, and wore clean clothes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c25 P45](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0045), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Mr. Harrison is an outspoken, cranky, and eccentric man who prides himself on bluntly telling the plain truth regardless of tact. Despite his fidgety, fussy, and irritable exterior, he is outwardly sympathetic, generous, and kind at heart. He enjoys simple pleasures like sitting on his veranda smoking a pipe or playing checkers. After reconciling with his wife, he became noticeably nicer and more settled.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 c6 P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 c9 P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c24 P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 c27 P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## History

Mr. Harrison originally lived in Scottsford, New Brunswick, where his sister kept house for him until her death. Before she died, he promised her he would marry Emily Scott. Upon marrying Emily, their opposing habits led to constant friction, particularly over his grammar, smoking, and his attachment to his deceased brother's swearing parrot, Ginger. The couple parted ways after a quarrel over the bird, and Mr. Harrison left New Brunswick to buy Mr. Robert Bell's farm in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island. In Avonlea, he lived as a bachelor, hired John Henry Carter, and quickly developed a reputation as an outspoken crank. He initially clashed with Anne Shirley over a Jersey cow, but they soon became good friends. Eventually, following Ginger's death, Emily tracked him down in Avonlea and reconciled with him. With his wife's return, Mr. Harrison's household settled down, and he began attending church regularly.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_
